import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('tasks/3-8/testbed/data/company_revenues.xlsx')
ws = wb.active

# Create new workbook
new_wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
new_ws = new_wb.active

# Copy header
new_ws.append([ws.cell(1,1).value, ws.cell(1,2).value])

# Filter rows where revenue >= 3000000
for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    year, revenue = row
    if revenue >= 3000000:
        new_ws.append([year, revenue])

new_wb.save('tasks/3-8/testbed/data/new.xlsx')
print('Saved new.xlsx')
EOF
python3 /tmp/filter_excel.py"}

from docx import Document
import openpyxl

# Read filtered data
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('tasks/3-8/testbed/data/new.xlsx')
ws = wb.active

# Create document
doc = Document()
doc.add_heading('Company Revenue Report', 0)
doc.add_paragraph('Years with revenue greater than or equal to $3,000,000:')

# Add table
table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=2)
table.style = 'Light Grid Accent 1'
hdr = table.rows[0].cells
hdr[0].text = 'Year'
hdr[1].text = 'Revenue ($)'

for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    year, revenue = row
    cells = table.add_row().cells
    cells[0].text = str(year)
    cells[1].text = str(revenue)

doc.save('tasks/3-5/testbed/data/report.docx')
print('Report saved')
EOF
python3 /tmp/create_report.py"}

from docx import Document
import openpyxl

# Read filtered data
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('tasks/3-8/testbed/data/new.xlsx')
ws = wb.active

# Create document
doc = Document()
doc.add_heading('Company Revenue Report', 0)
doc.add_paragraph('Years with revenue greater than or equal to ,000,000:')

# Add table
table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=2)
table.style = 'Light Grid Accent 1'
hdr = table.rows[0].cells
hdr[0].text = 'Year'
hdr[1].text = 'Revenue ($)'

for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=2, values_only=True):
    year, revenue = row
    cells = table.add_row().cells
    cells[0].text = str(year)
    cells[1].text = str(revenue)

doc.save('tasks/3-8/testbed/data/report.docx')
print('Report saved')
